original.statement: Cilium 1.16.0 introduces validation of the cluster name to require at most 32 lower case alphanumeric characters and hyphens, starting and ending with alphanumeric characters; this can be temporarily bypassed with upgradeCompatibility set to v1.15 or earlier, but will be strictly enforced in v1.17.

decision.reason: [ev-6e35b4906b1d] says the Cilium cluster name is now validated (at most 32 lowercase alphanumeric characters and '-', starting and ending with an alphanumeric character). That means names accepted before can now fail, so validation-tightened is the right change type. The bypass goes through `upgradeCompatibility`, which is a Helm value, and the values validator confirmed that `cluster.name` is a key of the cilium chart in both releases [ev-28e0ccb5774a][ev-39a22d88e2f5]. Together these make helm-value `cluster.name` the most likely subject. Confidence is low because the upstream text never names the key itself.
